title: pimelea curviflora subsp. subglabrata
intro: Pimelea curviflora subsp. subglabrata, commonly known as the Rough Bush-pea, is a plant species belonging to the family Thymelaeaceae. It has been traditionally used in Australian herbal medicine, offering various health benefits, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which support the immune system and aid in wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Pimelea curviflora subsp. subglabrata include its ability to reduce inflammation, fight against infections, and promote tissue repair. Research has identified the presence of bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to the plant's medicinal properties.
